Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryBlendSourceLedger

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryBlendSourceLedger
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryBlendSourceLedger extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, label-addressable source ledger for a qualified refinery blend batch.

Source identifiers are caller metadata in the exact order of the batch arrays. This class copies the already-qualified batch receipts; it does not infer source identity, alter blend calculations, or attest provenance.

    • fromBatch

      public static RefineryBlendSourceLedger fromBatch(String[] sourceIdentifiers, RefineryBlendBatch batch)
      Pair caller source identifiers with one qualified batch receipt.
      Parameters:
      sourceIdentifiers - unique nonblank identifiers in exact batch source order
      batch - qualified immutable blend batch
      Returns:
      immutable label-addressable source ledger
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if batch is null
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid or mismatched source identifiers
      IllegalStateException - if copied source receipts do not close to the batch
